macro_rules! m {
    ($($t:tt)*) => {};
}

fn m_none() {
    m!(a);
}

fn m_and(a: bool, b: bool) {
    m!(a && b);
}

fn m_or(a: bool, b: bool) {
    m!(a || b);
}

fn m_try(x: i32) {
    m!(x?);
}

fn m_if(a: bool) {
    m!(if a { 1 } else { 2 });
}

fn m_else_if(a: bool, b: bool) {
    m!(if a { 1 } else if b { 2 } else { 3 });
}

fn m_for(y: i32) {
    m!(for x in y {});
}

fn m_while(a: bool) {
    m!(while a {});
}

fn m_loop() {
    m!(loop {});
}

fn m_match(a: i32) {
    m!(match a { 0 => 1, _ => 2 });
}

fn m_guard(a: i32) {
    m!(match a { x if x > 0 => 1, _ => 2 });
}

fn m_closure(a: bool) {
    m!(|x| if x { 1 } else { 2 });
}

fn m_empty_closure() {
    m!(|| 1);
}

fn m_nested(a: bool) {
    m!(m!(if a { 1 } else { 2 }));
}

fn m_assert_and(a: bool, b: bool) {
    assert!(a && b);
}

fn m_format_if(a: bool) -> String {
    format!("{}", if a { 1 } else { 2 })
}

fn m_matches_guard(x: Option<i32>) -> bool {
    matches!(x, Some(v) if v > 0)
}

fn m_matches_or(x: Option<i32>) -> bool {
    matches!(x, Some(1) | Some(2))
}

fn m_dbg_try(s: &str) -> Result<i32, std::num::ParseIntError> {
    let v = dbg!(s.parse::<i32>()?);
    Ok(v)
}

fn m_stmt_macro(a: bool) {
    m! { if a { 1 } else { 2 } }
}

fn m_item_position(a: bool) {
    let _x = vec![if a { 1 } else { 2 }];
}
